title: VoltPeer 100-paper battery language evidence corpus
purpose: Evidence-informed vocabulary, reporting boundaries and editorial safeguards; not a scientific performance meta-analysis or language-frequency benchmark

sampling.method: purposive open-access convenience sample, 10 query buckets with 10 unique DOI journal articles each
sampling.year_definition: earliest of Europe PMC first publication year and Crossref published-online year; issue_year preserves the indexed issue year

screened_exclusion.reason: battery scrap alloy recycling falls outside electrochemistry-focused final bucket

queries.lithium_ion: (TITLE:"lithium-ion" OR TITLE:"lithium ion") AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries)
queries.lithium_metal: (TITLE:"lithium metal" OR TITLE:"lithium-metal") AND (electrolyte OR interphase OR interface OR battery)
queries.sodium: TITLE:sodium AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries) AND (anode OR cathode OR electrolyte)
queries.aqueous_zinc: TITLE:zinc AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries) AND (aqueous OR electrolyte OR anode)
queries.solid_state: (TITLE:"solid-state" OR TITLE:"solid state") AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries OR TITLE:electrolyte)
queries.solvation: TITLE:solvation AND (battery OR batteries) AND (lithium OR sodium OR zinc)
queries.interfaces: (TITLE:interphase OR TITLE:interface OR TITLE:interfacial) AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries)
queries.performance: (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries) AND (TITLE:"fast charging" OR TITLE:"fast-charging" OR TITLE:degradation OR TITLE:"coulombic efficiency" OR TITLE:"practical")
queries.redox_flow: (TITLE:"redox flow" OR TITLE:"flow battery" OR TITLE:"flow batteries")
queries.sulfur_and_multivalent: (TITLE:"lithium-sulfur" OR TITLE:"sodium-sulfur" OR TITLE:magnesium OR TITLE:potassium OR TITLE:aluminum OR TITLE:aluminium) AND (TITLE:battery OR TITLE:batteries)

limitations: Open-access and database-coverage selection bias; heavy concentration in four journals and 2025 online publication.
Published prose can contain typos, imprecise units, hype, conflicting metric assignments or an author correction; inclusion does not endorse every claim.
Metadata verification is distinct from scientific claim verification; selected paragraph reading is distinct from reading an entire article.
No article abstracts, paragraphs, figures, experimental data, PDFs or XML are redistributed in this public reference directory.
